mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.customer_id AS customerId, c.name AS name, c.phone_number AS phoneNumber, c.email AS email, r.reservation_date AS reservationDate, r.reservation_time AS reservationTime, r.number_of_people AS numberOfPeople, r.property_name AS propertyName, r.visited AS visited, r.memo AS memo FROM reservation r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY r.reservation_date,r.reservation_time

SELECT r.id, r.customer_id AS customerId, c.name AS name, c.phone_number AS phoneNumber, c.email AS email, r.reservation_date AS reservationDate, r.reservation_time AS reservationTime, r.number_of_people AS numberOfPeople, r.property_name AS propertyName, r.visited AS visited, r.memo AS memo FROM reservation r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.reservation_date = #{reservationDate} ORDER BY r.reservation_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation( customer_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, number_of_people, property_name, memo ) VALUES( #{customerId}, #{reservationDate}, #{reservationTime}, #{numberOfPeople}, #{propertyName}, #{memo} )
